notes.title: Dark Bunny - 0.6.6
notes.notes:
I have added a few more features revolving around Blackberries and some more end-game replayability with the new fertilizer level scaling. As always, I appreciate any feedback!

I'll just put both the 0.6.5 and 0.6.6 changelog in here, as the 0.6.5 apparently didnt go live.

[h2]Version 0.6.6 [11/15/2023][/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added fertilizer levels, to increase blackberry drop chance and game difficulty
[*] New Forager passive
[*] Blackberry rewards from challenges
[*] Added blackberry bonus for winning a game
[*] Report tracking of armor effeciency and damage dodged
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Demonics health loss per second
[*] Increased Minecrafter mines trigger size
[*] Reduced base blackberry drop chance, but higher difficulties increases the drop chance
[*] Changed blackberry shop prices to be more streamlined
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Disabling permanent stats settings not working for blackberry stats
[*] A loophole, that allowed cheating by modifying game files
[/list]

[h2]Version 0.6.5 [11/13/2023][/h2]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Death Instructions trigger chance
[*] Reduced Chain bombs trigger chance
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Demonic losing too much health per second
[*] Issue where Blackberries would not get loaded correctly when opening the game
[*] Issue where Blackberries would show accumulated amount in reports
[/list]

notes.title: Dark Bunny 0.6.4 - Now with Blackberries
notes.notes:
It has been a very interesting first week since Dark Bunny launched into Early Access!

I want to THANK everyone, that has bought and played the game. I really hope you enjoy it!
Feel free to let me know your thoughts on the discord channel.

I would also very much welcome reviews here on Steam!

Today I have an interesting update for you; Introducing the Blackberries!
This is a new meta-progression system, which gives every run (won or lost) potential to make you better. There are also a few other fixes:

[h2]Version 0.6.4 [11/12/2023][/h2]
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Blackberry Shop, where you can buy permanent stat upgrades
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced Hell Stone stat gains from 12/12/4 to 10/10/3
[*] Reduced Grand Elfs Health penalty from -30 to -25 %
[*] Increased enemy health and damage slightly in higher difficulties
[*] Increased Death Instructions trigger chance from 30 to 40 % and increased its base dps from 5 to 10.
[*] Set default sound levels to 50% instead of 100%
[/list]


[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue with Hell Stone dealing too much damage
[*] Bullet shower projectile visual missing
[*] (Hopefully) Fixed an issue, where enemies could end up outside the map
[/list]

notes.title: Dark Bunny - 0.6.3 update
notes.notes:
The first patch update since the Early Access Launch. I have fixed a few issues, made some balancing (made the game a little easier overall) and added a few more items :)

[h1]Version 0.6.3 [11/8/2023][/h1]
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] - New item "Dank Noir Ode" (guess the reference)
[*] - New "Down the rabbit hole" passive, locked behind an achievement
[*] - Message of what killed yo, when you die
[*] - Several achievements yielding stats by killing a number of enemies
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] - Shop cost now gets red, if you don't have enough carrots
[*] - Reduced the effectiveness of Health Regen and added a health per second calculation
[*] - Increased Poison Daggers CD by 0.2s and reduced its range by 0/0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4
[*] - Reduced Critter identity armor penalty by 10 and reduced Etheral Protection CD by 2s
[*] - Increased Healthy passive health regen from 4 to 5
[*] - Slightly reduced enemy health
[*] - Reduced Apples challenge tree spawn increase
[*] - Increased transparency on Great Barrier
[*] - Reduced Bear health
[*] - Slightly increased Shredders base damage
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] - A few typos
[*] - Visual issue where skills were selectable by keyboard while entering/exiting a level
[*] - Issue where shop items with sub skills (summon skills) would be difficult to navigate to by keyboard
[/list]

notes.title: Dark Bunny - Early Access!
notes.notes:
Finally I am ready to release the first version of Dark Bunny into Early Access.

I hope you will have a good time playing it!
I would love to get any kind of feedback, either on Steam or on Discord, so you can have an even better time playing it :D
